title: Fixed Curved Keyed Saxophone Display
description: One newly authored complete static saxophone display exterior. A single continuous thick hollow variable-radius tube runs through a curved upper neck, long inclined body, low semicircular return and widening upright open bell. A separate dark open mouth sleeve seats on the upper tube. A whole front key shaft, two real shaft supports and six separate closed key cups with touch faces and lever bridges form the fixed keyed exterior. A complete low grounded display stand has a bow cradle and a rear body support. All instrument geometry is new, not the old low horizontal looped bugle raised on end, separate open organ pipes combined, or a reshaped pocket harmonica. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, native Z up, full horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. One complete instrument-with-display-support prop, zero scenes. Fixed illustrative exterior only: closed key cups do not claim actual tone-hole operation; no reed, airflow, acoustic tuning, fingering accuracy, music, key motion, instrument playability, manufacture, support load or safety claim.
